context: Theorem 9 ((Rubinstein, 2018)) There is a constant ϵ > 0 so that ϵ-GCircuit is PPAD- complete. The problem of (ϵ, δ)-GCircuit for positive δ is not (yet) known to be PPAD-hard, but it has been conjectured to be so: Conjecture 10 (PCP for PPAD conjecture (Babichenko et al., 2015)) There are constants ϵ, δ > 0 so that EOTL has a polynomial-time reduction to (ϵ, δ)-GCircuit. We remark that Conjecture 10 is slightly weaker (i.e., more plausible) than (Babichenko et al., 2015, Conjecture 2), which states that the reduction is quasilinear. Further, we remark that the definition of ϵ-GCircuit in Rubinstein (2018) uses some additional gates; it is straightforward to see that these gates may be implemented using the gates in Definition 8, meaning that the ϵ-GCircuit problem with the set of gates listed above is still PPAD- complete for constant ϵ (and Conjecture 10 is implied by (Babichenko et al., 2015, Conjecture 2)). For completeness, we have presented the details of this reduction in Appendix D.
